svg.aria-label: Four dotplots of 40 values of a statistic each, from four methods, against a parameter of 50. Unbiased methods centre on 50; biased methods centre near 66. High-variability methods spread widely; low-variability methods cluster tightly. A biased method with low variability clusters tightly around the wrong value.
svg.text: dashed line: the parameter, 50 · each dot: the statistic from one sample
